name: Saimin Datsujo 2 ~Subete ga Boku no Jiyuu ni Naru Sekai e Youkoso~ Mikado Azusa Hen
original_name: 催眠奪女2 ～全てが僕の自由になる世界へようこそ～ 三門梓編
source:
Okamura Yuto is a quiet, introverted high school student living an otherwise ordinary life—until he receives a peculiar package from his archaeologist father. Inside is a strange, plate-like artifact etched with mysterious symbols. According to his father, it’s said to be an ancient relic with hypnotic powers—capable of putting people into a trance and accepting any suggestion given.

Initially dismissing it as another of his father’s odd souvenirs, Yuto’s curiosity eventually gets the better of him. To his surprise, the relic works exactly as described.

As Yuto experiments with its power, memories of a childhood friend resurface—Azusa, now a member of the track and field club. Once close, they’ve since drifted apart, but seeing her dedication and graceful figure reignites Yuto’s interest.

Driven by newfound feelings, he uses the artifact to reconnect with Azusa. Their conversations grow deeper—revisiting the past, sharing present thoughts, and slowly rekindling a lost bond. When he invites her to his room, Yuto learns that Azusa secretly has a crush on an older member of her club.

Though briefly discouraged, Yuto is surprised—and intrigued—to learn that her crush is actually a woman. Azusa, struggling with insecurities about her performance in track and her appearance, wishes to improve and grow. Wanting to support her honestly, Yuto decides to use the artifact not just for connection, but to help her reach her potential.

Yet, what begins as innocent support starts to blur. Under the pretense of helping with massages and training, Yuto finds himself increasingly captivated by Azusa’s athletic, youthful charm...

[Translated from the [url=http://www.silkyssakura.jp/saimindatuzyo/series2.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
冈村悠斗是个安静、内向的高中生，原本过着普通的生活。直到某天，身为考古学家的父亲寄来一个奇怪的包裹。里面是一块板状的古代遗物，上面刻着神秘纹样。据父亲所说，它拥有催眠的力量，能让人陷入恍惚，并接受任何暗示。

起初，悠斗只把它当成父亲又一次寄来的古怪纪念品，可好奇心终究占了上风。他试用后惊讶地发现，遗物的力量竟与描述完全一致。

摸索这股力量时，他想起了青梅竹马梓。如今，梓是田径部的一员。两人曾经亲近，后来却渐渐疏远，可看见她专心训练、身姿优美的模样，悠斗又重新在意起她来。

怀着新生的感情，他借助遗物，再次与梓拉近距离。他们的交谈逐渐深入，回顾过去，分享近况，一点点重拾失落的羁绊。将她邀请到房间后，悠斗得知，梓正暗恋着田径部的一位前辈。

悠斗短暂地感到失落，却惊讶又好奇地发现，她憧憬的对象竟是一位女性。梓对田径成绩与自己的外表都缺乏自信，渴望变得更好、取得成长。悠斗真心想支持她，决定运用遗物的力量，帮助她发挥潜能，而不只是借此拉近关系。

然而，最初单纯的支持，渐渐变得暧昧。他以协助按摩与训练为由，发现自己正越来越被梓充满活力的青春魅力吸引……
